title: lathyrus nevadensis var. pilosellus
intro: Lathyrus nevadensis var. pilosellus, commonly known as the Nevada pea or hairy pea, is a variety of flowering plant in the pea family. The Nevada pea has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, making it useful for treating conditions such as high blood pressure and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus nevadensis var. pilosellus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
